assays.assay_name: Memory retrieval-reconsolidation of alcohol-related memory (operant self-administration)
assays.assay_description: After self-administration training and 3-week abstinence, a 5-min retrieval session (first two presses reinforced) was followed immediately by psilocybin (5 mg/kg, i.p.); 24 h later a 30-min non-reinforced reinstatement test, repeated weekly (3 tests across ~2 weeks). Active and inactive lever presses recorded.

application_type.evidence: rats received psilocybin or its vehicle ... i.p. psilocybin (5 m/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals trained in the operant chamber prior to testing; 5-min retrieval session served as memory reactivation in the same apparatus.

food_restriction.evidence: 30-min operant test in chamber without food access.

water_restriction.evidence: 30-min operant test in chamber without water access.

time_to_assay.evidence: Immediately after this 5-min memory reactivation session, rats received psilocybin ... Twenty-four hours later, rats were subjected to another 30-min self-administration session ... this procedure was repeated ... A third memory reactivation test was carried out after one additional week.

sample_size.evidence: Male (N = 8) and female (N = 8) msP rats ... equally distributed into 2 groups

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin given immediately after a 5-min alcohol-memory retrieval session significantly reduced active lever presses during subsequent reinstatement tests at 24 h and at weekly re-tests, without affecting inactive lever responding.
outcomes.statistics: Active lever: treatment F(1,14)=9.6, p<0.01; time F(2,14)=9.7, p<0.01; interaction F(2,28)=1.9, p>0.05. Inactive: treatment F(1,14)=0.5, p>0.05; time F(2,14)=0.7, p>0.05.
outcomes.evidence: two-way ANOVA revealed a significant effect of treatment [F(1,14)=9.6; p<0.01] and time [F(2,14)=9.7; p<0.01]

B1_num_measures.evidence: Responses at both the active and inactive levers were recorded.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total responses per 30-min test reported; no within-session binning.

E3_bedding.evidence: orange flavor extract deposited on the bedding of the operant chamber before every session

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water available during 30-min test (a small amount of alcohol delivered during the 5-min retrieval).

D1_continuity.evidence: 5-min retrieval, 30-min test 24 h later, repeated weekly with a third test one week later.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Retrieval day + 24 h test, then repeated weekly (3 reinstatement tests).

D4_baseline.evidence: In the 5-min retrieval phase, active lever responses were 20.6 ± 7.4 for the vehicle group and 23.1 ± 7 for the psilocybin group (data recorded before drug).

D5_followup.evidence: Twenty-four hours later, rats were subjected to another 30-min self-administration session ... third memory reactivation test was carried out after one additional week.

judge_notes: Kept the two-bottle-choice baseline (Exp 1) and the ADE assay (Exp 2) as SEPARATE assays because Exp 2 includes a 3-week deprivation manipulation distinguishing it as a relapse paradigm; gptoss merged them but the paper analyses them as different experiments with different statistical models.

Kept cue-induced reinstatement (Exp 3) and memory reconsolidation (Exp 4) as separate assays because the protocols differ meaningfully (single 30-min reinstatement vs retrieval+reconsolidation paradigm with multiple test sessions); gptoss merged them.
B1: counted alcohol + water + food intake as 3 measures (score 2 = 2-3) for drinking assays; gptoss treated as 2-3 (1 pt), glm as 2-3 (2 pt). Adopted score=2/value 2-3 consensus where applicable.
B2 temporal dynamics: scored Yes for 2BC/ADE because intake was recorded at 2, 8 and 24 h within the same continuous recording (within-session time course).

D4 baseline: scored Yes for drinking assays (last 3 days of drinking pre-drug used as baseline) and for the reconsolidation assay (5-min retrieval data recorded before drug). Scored No for cue-induced reinstatement because operant training baseline differed in reinforcement contingencies.

D5 follow-up: scored No for 2BC and ADE because recording starts 12 h after dosing and ends at 24 h after re-exposure (~36 h post-dose), but the recording is a single continuous session begun before 24 h; scored Yes for reconsolidation due to weekly re-tests.
